items.title: Next.js: The final boss of Web Performance
items.summary: Your local Lighthouse test shows a perfect 100, but when your app hits the real-world production stage, it’s instant Game Over. Why does Next.js feel so fast in development and yet so easy to break in production? In this talk, we’ll demystify what actually happens between the server and the browser, from SSR and streaming to hydration and Core Web Vitals. You’ll walk away with actionable mental models, common pitfall fixes, and the real strategies needed to conquer Next.js performance at scale.
